The '''2021–22 Serie A''' (known as the '''Serie A [[Telecom Italia|TIM]]''' for sponsorship reasons) was the 120th season of top-tier Italian [[association football|football]], the 90th in a [[round-robin tournament]], and the 12th since its organization under an own league committee, the [[Lega Serie A]].<ref>[https://www.legaseriea.it/en Lega Serie A.] ''www.legaseriea.it''.</ref> [[AC Milan]] won the title after defeating [[US Sassuolo Calcio|Sassuolo]] 3–0 at the [[Mapei Stadium – Città del Tricolore]] on 22 May 2022, the final matchday of the season.<ref>{{cite news |date=22 May 2022 |title=AC Milan win Serie A title for first time in 11 years after victory at Sassuolo |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/61542278 |access-date=22 May 2022 |publisher=BBC Sport}}</ref>

AC Milan's title marked their 19th league title in their history and their first since [[2010–11 Serie A|2011]]. [[Inter Milan]], the defending champions, finished in second place, two points behind AC Milan. 

==Teams== 
Two teams, [[Venezia FC|Venezia]] and [[US Salernitana 1919|Salernitana]], both returned to the [[Serie A]] after historically long absences. Venezia defeated [[AS Cittadella|Cittadella]] in the final of the promotion playoffs to secure readmission into the top league for the first time in 19 years—since the 2001-2002 season.<ref>{{cite news |date=27 May 2021 |title=Venezia promoted to Serie A |url=https://football-italia.net/venezia-promoted-to-serie-a/ |access-date=27 May 2021 |website=Football Italia}}</ref> Salernitana, meanwhile, were able to play their first Serie A match in 23 years, for the first time since 1999.<ref>{{cite news |date=10 May 2021 |title=Serie B, scatta la festa della Salernitana: in Serie A dopo 22 anni d'assenza |url=https://www.tuttomercatoweb.com/serie-b/serie-b-scatta-la-festa-della-salernitana-in-serie-a-dopo-22-anni-d-assenza-1532503 |access-date=10 May 2021 |website=Tutto Mercato |language=it}}</ref> [[Empoli FC|Empoli]] returned after a two-year absence.<ref>{{Cite news |date=4 May 2021 |title=L'Empoli è promosso in Serie A! 4-0 al Cosenza, i toscani risalgono dopo due anni in B |url=https://www.tuttomercatoweb.com/serie-b/l-empoli-e-promosso-in-serie-a-4-0-al-cosenza-i-toscani-risalgono-dopo-due-anni-in-b-1529759 |access-date=4 May 2021 |website=Tutto Mercato |language=it}}</ref>

[[FC Crotone|Crotone]] and [[Benevento Calcio|Benevento]] were relegated to the [[Serie B]] after spending just one year each in the Serie A. [[Parma Calcio 1913|Parma]] was relegated after a three-year stint.
